sketches.mechanism: The '=' operator is pattern matching over single-assignment variables; a bound variable cannot be made to match a different atom.
sketches.resonance: What has been named as gone cannot be renamed into presence without the program breaking.

sketches.mechanism: ARC zeroes weak references automatically when the last strong reference leaves scope.
sketches.resonance: Memory keeps no body by force; when the holding ends, the reference becomes nil by law.

sketches.mechanism: Assigning nil to a table field removes the key rather than storing a nil value.
sketches.resonance: In this language, absence is not kept in a place; it erases the place itself.
